requirement_summary: Unregistered user can view approved reports on an interactive map.
prompt: Execute a GET request to /reports/approved without any authentication headers. Verify that the response returns a list of report objects containing only public fields (e.g., title, status, location) and excludes sensitive internal comments or user emails.
rationale: Validates the core requirement that unregistered users can access public data without authentication.

requirement_summary: Unregistered user can view approved reports on an interactive map.
prompt: Execute a GET request to /reports/approved without authentication. Verify that the response returns a list of report objects containing only public fields (e.g., title, status, location) and excludes sensitive internal comments or user emails.
rationale: Tests the edge case where an unregistered user accesses the API without any prior setup, ensuring data privacy constraints are met.

requirement_summary: Technical office staff member assigns reports to external maintainers.
prompt: Authenticate as a 'technical_office_staff_member'. Execute a PUT request to /reports/{id}/mainteiner with an invalid maintainer ID (non-existent user). Verify that the system returns an appropriate error code (e.g., 404 or 400) and does not create an assignment.
setup_needed: Create a report via POST /reports with mandatory fields.
cleanup_strategy: Verify no resource was created; delete the report using DELETE /reports/{id} if it still exists.
rationale: Tests negative behavior where an invalid maintainer ID is provided, ensuring the system handles errors gracefully.

requirement_summary: Technical office staff member updates report statuses.
prompt: Authenticate as a 'technical_office_staff_member'. Execute a PUT request to /reports/{id}/status with status 'Suspended' and then immediately attempt to update it again to 'Resolved' without proper workflow steps. Verify that the system enforces the correct state transitions.
setup_needed: Assign the report to a technical office or staff member via PUT /reports/{id}/mainteiner.
cleanup_strategy: Delete the created report using DELETE /reports/{id} after verification.
rationale: Tests stateful workflow where multiple status updates are performed in sequence, ensuring correct state management.

requirement_summary: Citizen registers with name and username to access the system.
prompt: Execute a happy path registration. Provide a valid JSON body with 'name', 'username', and 'email'. Expect a success response indicating account creation pending verification.
cleanup_strategy: Delete created resources or restore their previous state.
rationale: Validates the core entry point for new users as per PT01.

requirement_summary: Citizen confirms registration with a code to activate account.
prompt: Execute the happy path for email verification. First, call /citizens/verification-code (auth_required: true) to generate a valid code. Then, call /citizens/verify-email with that code in the body. Expect account activation.
setup_needed: Call POST /citizens/verification-code to obtain a valid verification code.
cleanup_strategy: Delete created resources or restore their previous state.
rationale: Validates the stateful workflow required by PT27 and domain rules regarding confirmation codes.

requirement_summary: Technical office staff exchanges internal comments on a report.
prompt: Execute the happy path for adding an internal comment. Use an authenticated session with role 'technical_office_staff'. Provide a JSON body with 'content' and optionally 'author_id'. Expect success.
setup_needed: Ensure an existing report ID is available (e.g., create a dummy report or use a known ID).
cleanup_strategy: Delete created resources or restore their previous state.
rationale: Validates the internal communication channel defined in PT26.

requirement_summary: Citizen replies to messages from municipal operators in the platform.
prompt: Execute a stateful workflow for messaging. First, ensure an authenticated citizen session exists. Then, POST a message to /reports/{id}/messages with 'sender_id' (operator) and 'content'. Verify the message is created.
setup_needed: Ensure an existing report ID is available.
Ensure an authenticated citizen session exists.
cleanup_strategy: Delete created resources or restore their previous state.
rationale: Validates the chat functionality defined in PT18 and API analysis for message creation.

requirement_summary: System administrator assigns roles to municipality users.
prompt: Create a new municipality user with a specific role assigned (e.g., 'technical_office_staff') using the admin session. Ensure the payload includes valid email and password fields required for registration.
setup_needed: Authenticate as system administrator to obtain a valid session token.
cleanup_strategy: Delete created resources or restore their previous state.
rationale: Validates the core functionality of creating users with roles, which is a prerequisite for other admin operations like assigning categories or modifying roles.

requirement_summary: System administrator modifies roles to municipality users.
prompt: Update an existing municipality user's role from 'citizen' to 'technical_office_staff' using the admin session. Include all necessary fields for a successful update.
setup_needed: Create a test user via POST /admin/createuser to have an ID to modify.
cleanup_strategy: Delete the created test user via DELETE /citizens/{id} if it was not intended to persist, or verify no resource was created if the update failed unexpectedly.
rationale: Tests the ability of administrators to flexibly modify user roles as per requirement PT10.
